My SE phone with 4GB of RAM went handle the new heavier WebKit rendering. I’m switching to CoPilot which has a lighter WebKit for the phone. If you are seeing a black screen or getting slow performance, you can switch to CoPilot. This is terrible that ChatGPT did this recently. I’m glad I didn’t upgrade to a paid plan. They are basically making it so 50% of us cannot use the software bc the new updates are too RAM heavy for so many phones."
